name: agentboard
description: Terminal-native Kanban board for managing AI coding sessions

scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:go
scripts.build:go: mkdir -p .cache/go-build .cache/go-path .cache/go-mod dist-go && GOCACHE="$PWD/.cache/go-build" GOPATH="$PWD/.cache/go-path" GOMODCACHE="$PWD/.cache/go-mod" go build -o dist-go/agentboard-tui ./cmd/agentboard-tui
scripts.build:ts: tsc && mkdir -p dist/db/migrations && cp src/db/migrations/*.sql dist/db/migrations/
scripts.reset-deamon: node dist/bin/agentboard.js daemon stop && node dist/bin/agentboard.js daemon start
scripts.reset-daemon: node dist/bin/agentboard.js daemon stop && node dist/bin/agentboard.js daemon start
